lighting: Land uses sun/hemisphere lighting. Ocean color follows day/night and matches screen-space ocean backdrop.
scope: Worldwide Natural Earth 1:10m land on the Fukuoka-centered plane. Detail crop 110–136E / 28–54N, Ulleungdo, schematic Dokdo and the Kyushu outline stay fine. Dateline fragments are joined onto their continents so no landmass ends in a straight meridian cut.
source: Natural Earth 1:10m countries (South Korea) and land, public domain; existing Fukuoka coast OpenStreetMap ODbL
worldCut: Dateline pieces such as Chukotka are shifted onto the rest of their continent. Land is not split at the prime meridian. The Americas stay west of Fukuoka.
dokdoGeometry: Two schematic 12-sided islands at published coordinates and areas; no detailed coastline or satellite rocks.
